response_text: This project is the Earned Autonomy Engine, an AI governance system that controls how much spending authority AI agents have when approving invoices. It starts agents at a low spending limit (₹500) and uses statistical evidence—like accuracy proven by Wilson lower bounds, drift detection, and a weighted trust score—to decide if they can earn higher limits step-by-step up to ₹10,000. Humans must approve every increase, while automatic clawbacks reduce authority immediately if performance drops or critical errors occur, ensuring safety by never granting authority without strong evidence and human oversight.
